```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Socialists have a duty to firmly oppose militarism and police tyranny.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should clearly oppose the imperialist designs of the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any socialist program in the United States must firmly oppose colonialism and advance the principles of national self-determination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Each country must be sovereign to decide its own affairs, free from military coercion or economic extortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should take a defeatist stance against the wars of the United States, including those engaged by proxies and through military alliances like NATO.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should oppose cruel economic sanctions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should oppose military and diplomatic cover for colonial occupation, police repression, and ethnic cleansing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A lasting transition to socialism in any one country is impossible.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The working class can only emancipate itself on an international scale.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The decline of much of the socialist movement in the 20th century into variant forms of nationalism and popular frontism led to strategic dead-ends and tragic defeat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Domestic reforms are only partial victories for an international class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Socialists have a duty to stand firmly against militarism and police tyranny, beginning with a clear opposition to the imperialist designs of their own state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any socialist program in the belly of the American empire must firmly oppose colonialism and advance the principles of national self-determination—that each country must be sovereign to decide its own affairs, free from military coercion or economic extortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should take a defeatist stance against their country's wars, including those engaged by proxies and through military alliances like NATO, as well as cruel economic sanctions and military and diplomatic cover for colonial occupation, police repression, and ethnic cleansing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A lasting transition to socialism in any one country is impossible.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The working class can only emancipate itself on an international scale.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The decline of much of the socialist movement in the 20th century into variant forms of nationalism and popular frontism—from the official communist 'national roads to socialism' to the earlier capitulation of social democracy to 'defense of the nation' during WWI—has equally led to strategic dead-ends and tragic defeat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Domestic reforms are only partial victories for an international class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
